items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: I studied with him for about three years. And he gave me classical training... and again a big influence

ctx.x: Good point. Very prevalent around here unfortunately. So did you continue your education in a more formal setting?

Yes I did. I went to a very formal school that we’ll just omit the name, and started to study there, and was not happy at all with the teaching staff and the direction I was going. Of course I had been out and playing, and I knew what I needed. I just wasn’t at their beck and call. I knew what I needed, and they weren’t giving it to me. So I pulled out of the school and started asking successful drummers and musicians about a good communicator. Not only a good player, but someone that could communicate that…
